releases.title: National county presidential comparison release
releases.summary: Complete available county and county-equivalent presidential comparison rows for 2016, 2020, and 2024.
releases.historicalGeographyPolicy: 2016 and 2020 rows resolve to the current canonical county-equivalent inventory. Connecticut official town rows are reproducibly aggregated to the nine planning-region county equivalents adopted by the Census Bureau in 2022; those derived current-geography rows are not historical county reporting units.
changes: Completed canonical FIPS joins for every available county and county-equivalent presidential row in 2016, 2020, and 2024.
Added permanent county profiles, national comparison APIs, confidence classifications, and a reproducible bulk release bundle.
Preserved Alaska as source-unavailable county geography rather than manufacturing county totals from non-comparable reporting units.
knownLimitations: Alaska reports election results through election districts and precinct/reporting units that do not provide a reviewed county-equivalent crosswalk for these years; its 30 Census county equivalents remain unavailable.
Maine UOCAVA and Rhode Island Federal Precincts are intentional non-geographic historical rows and are excluded from county comparisons.

Connecticut 2016 and 2020 values are derived current-geography aggregates from official town rows to the nine planning regions adopted as Census county equivalents in 2022; they are not totals reported by those planning regions in those elections.
Turnout, equipment, vote-method, advisory, and administrative context have different reporting grains and should not be assumed to cover every county.

releases.title: 2012 presidential historical baseline snapshot
releases.summary: Partial source-linked presidential baseline rows for the 28 states currently carrying normalized 2012 data.
changes: Published the normalized 2012 presidential baseline rows already retained by 28 state ETL packages.
Preserved source identifiers, parser methods, URLs, reporting grains, and row-level canonical-tag eligibility.
Separated the partial 2012 snapshot from the complete available 2016/2020/2024 national county product.
knownLimitations: Coverage is partial: 23 state or District of Columbia jurisdictions do not yet have normalized 2012 baseline rows in this release.
Only 120 rows currently carry reviewed canonical county tags; untagged rows must not be treated as national county-comparison matches.

Several state packages explicitly use supplemental Wikipedia county tables where official machine-readable historical sources were blocked or unavailable; row_method and source_url preserve that caveat.
This archive contains historical presidential result rows only. It does not include 2012 precinct geometry or make 2012 available through the live national comparison API.

releases.title: 2024 election equipment context release
releases.summary: Normalized, source-linked jurisdiction equipment context used by the Equipment tab across 50 states.
changes: Published one normalized national CSV assembled from the 50 retained state equipment-context files.
Preserved vendor, system, usage, paper-record, tabulation, source, and uniformity-warning fields.
Added an offline data dictionary, coverage statement, and hashed source-artifact inventory.
knownLimitations: District of Columbia is not present in the retained 2024 state equipment-context files.
The source is jurisdiction-level context and does not prove that every precinct, ballot mode, or fielded unit used one identical setup.
Equipment deployments and certifications can change after the 2024 snapshot; source URLs and row caveats should be reviewed before reuse.
The separately maintained detailed equipment dossier catalog is not included because its publication lifecycle is distinct from this context release.

releases.title: November 2024 election security incident release
releases.summary: Source-linked mixed-grain incident records and source inventory used by the national Security tab.
changes: Published the reviewed JSON registry, a flat CSV export, and the national source inventory used by the Security tab.
Preserved county and statewide-unspecified reporting grains without manufacturing county assignments.
Kept the separately classified non-bomb-threat public-safety response outside the documented 227-threat minimum.
knownLimitations: The 227 figure is a documented minimum from a public-source tracker, not an official FBI roster or an exhaustive national count.
Two tracker rows contain 66 threats whose counties were not specified; they remain statewide-unspecified and are not drawn on county polygons.
An absent county row means only that no matching record is loaded; it does not establish that no incident occurred.
Incident records are not evidence of fraud, misconduct, altered votes, or an incorrect election outcome.
